request.description:
Creates a new learning with automatic embedding generation.

**Required Fields:**
- project: Project name
- title: Learning title (becomes learning_id)
- content: Learning content
- dev_stream: Development area

**Optional Fields:**
- context: Additional context
- type: Pattern/Solution/Error/Decision/Insight/Anti-Pattern/Best Practice
- tags: Array of tags
- confidence: High/Medium/Low
- impact: Impact description

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "learning_id": "Postman API Testing Pattern",
  "page_id": "...",
  "url": "https://notion.so/...",
  "message": "Learning created successfully"
}
```

**Note:** Embedding generation happens asynchronously (takes ~2 seconds)

request.description: Example with all optional fields populated.

Performs semantic search across all learnings.

**Parameters:**
- query (required): Natural language search query
- limit (optional, default=5): Max results to return
- project (optional): Filter by project

**How it works:**
1. Query is converted to embedding via OpenAI
2. Vector similarity search in Supabase
3. Results ranked by cosine similarity
4. Returns learning content + metadata

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "query": "How to test APIs with Postman?",
  "count": 2,
  "results": [
    {
      "learning_id": "Postman API Testing Pattern",
      "content": "...",
      "similarity": 0.8234,
      "metadata": {
        "title": "Postman API Testing Pattern",
        "project": "Noel_SK",
        "dev_stream": "Testing",
        "tags": ["postman", "api"],
        "confidence": "High"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

**Note:** Similarity scores range from 0-1 (higher = more relevant)

Updates an existing learning. Only updates fields provided.

**Required:**
- learning_id: Must match the Title in Notion exactly

**Updatable Fields:**
- title: New title
- content: New content (triggers embedding regeneration)
- context: Updated context
- type: Pattern/Solution/Error/etc.
- dev_stream: Development area
- tags: Array of tags
- confidence: High/Medium/Low
- status: Validated/Hypothesis/Deprecated
- related_files: File references

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "title": "Postman API Testing Pattern",
  "page_id": "...",
  "url": "https://notion.so/...",
  "message": "Learning updated successfully"
}
```

**Important:** 
- learning_id must EXACTLY match the Notion page title
- If content is updated, embedding is regenerated (~2 seconds)
- Last Modified timestamp is automatically set

Submit feedback on which learnings were relevant to a query.

**Parameters:**
- query (required): The original query text
- relevant_learning_ids (required): Array of learning IDs that were helpful

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Thank you for the feedback! This helps improve search quality.",
  "query": "How to test APIs with Postman?",
  "relevant_learning_count": 2
}
```

**Note:** Currently returns success without storing to Supabase. Storage will be implemented via HTTP Request node.

request.description:
Starts a new coding session.

**Required:**
- projects: Array of project names
- goals: Session objectives (10-1000 chars)

**Optional:**
- recording_file_path: Path to asciinema recording
- ai_type: Claude/Gemini/Other (default: Other)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "session_id": "20251215-1200-noel-sk",
  "page_id": "...",
  "url": "https://notion.so/...",
  "message": "Session started successfully",
  "data": {
    "Status": "Active",
    "Start Time": "2025-12-15T12:00:00Z",
    "AI Type": "Claude",
    "Goals": "..."
  }
}
```

**Session ID Format:** YYYYMMDD-HHMM-project

Lists all sessions from Notion.

List sessions filtered by project and status.

Ends an active session and calculates duration.

**Required:**
- session_id: Session ID to end (from start_session response)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "session_id": "20251215-1200-noel-sk",
  "page_id": "...",
  "url": "https://notion.so/...",
  "message": "Session ended successfully",
  "data": {
    "Status": "Completed",
    "End Time": "2025-12-15T14:00:00Z",
    "Duration": 120,
    "Learning Count": 5
  }
}
```

**Note:** 
- Status changes from Active → Completed
- Duration is calculated in minutes
- Learning Count is a rollup from linked learnings
